digest.component_or_area: LLM config system and model class resolution
propositions: Single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express per-tier model mappings across four passes, causing verifier downgrades to silently stop applying and plan-review Pass-1 to route to Anthropic instead of configured provider

Class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must resolve via single function model_classes.resolve_model_string called at three separate bypass sites: config.resolve_model, batch runner ladder expansion, and verifier paths

REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE layering must deep-merge tables (preserving sibling keys like provider and fallback) and replace arrays wholesale (enabling explicit disablement via empty array), not shallow-merge
Workflow YAML uses reserved class names as values in existing model/model_ladder fields with no schema change, resolved at call time not load time to respect env/CLI layering

Per-pass model dispatch across multiple providers requires deep config merge and function-level imports to avoid module cycles while ensuring no verifier or ladder path receives unresolved class names
Operator-attested run confirms per-pass cross-provider routing: 41 calls to anthropic:claude-opus-4-8 (Pass-1 frontier) and 1 to bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 (Pass-2/4 standard verifier)
